# fire-layer (vendored)

`fire-layer.js` and `fire-layer.d.ts` are copied **verbatim** from the standalone
fire_animation project (`src/`), 2026-09-18. It is a single dependency-free MapLibre
custom layer: GPU-instanced low-poly flames, one per hotspot, with a GPU time filter.

Do not edit these two files here. Tune the look through the options passed in
`../../layers/hotspotFlamesLayer.ts`; to take a newer version, re-copy both files.
The full option reference lives in that project's README.
